text:
sam: Quick postmortem follow-up. Outage chain: cloud auth latency spike -> token refresh stampede from many clients -> model-registry queue growth -> serving timeouts. Need owners + short mitigations + a recurring review cadence.

tara: I'll take the gateway work: enforce 2 max retries on auth failures, add exponential backoff with jitter, and implement a circuit that fails fast to cached tokens after N errors. Draft PR by Mon.

ben: On model-registry: implement cached-token fallback on 5xx + safety TTL + emit metrics (token_refresh_count, token_refresh_error_rate, token_refresh_latency_p95). Staging by Thu.

maria: I'll handle vendor escalation and logs. Opening case now, requesting token endpoint traces and a timeline. Will post case # and any provider findings by EOD.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-5627 created: "auth -> token churn mitigation". Temporary owner: sam. DR drill scheduled 2027-04-26 11:00 UTC.

sam: Short-term mitigation to ship today if possible: reduce gateway auth retries to 1 for 5xx, add 300ms base backoff + jitter, and enable token-refresh rate-limit at the client (1rps per replica). Who can push this?

tara: I can ship the gateway change now behind FF. Will open PR and mark for immediate canary.

ben: I'll enable cached-token fallback in registry client and add the Grafana panels. Will also add an alert: token_refresh_error_rate > 0.4% for 5m -> P1.

sam: Action list (owners + due dates):
- A1 (tara): Gateway retry cap + backoff + circuit-breaker. PR by Mon 2027-03-29, canary Wed.
- A2 (ben): Model-registry cached-token fallback + metrics + dashboard. Staging Thu 2027-04-01, prod 2027-04-08.
- A3 (maria): Vendor escalation + logs + playbook updates. Case # by EOD.
- A4 (ops-bot): DR runbook snippet + schedule. DR 2027-04-26.
- A5 (sam): CI e2e that simulates auth latency and validates fallback paths. Test in CI by 2027-04-05.

maria: Provider acknowledged a spike at 2027-03-27T02:10Z and is providing traces. Will post summaries and any proposed mitigations.

ops-bot: INC-5627 updated: owners assigned (tara,ben,maria,sam), due dates added, DR attached.

tara: I'll add a small canary monitor: if token-refresh_error_rate spikes during deploy we auto-roll back.

ben: Adding CI scenario to simulate 500ms auth latency and token 5xx to ensure fallback.

sam: We saw this pattern several times. Proposal: 8-week "dependency resilience" rotation, 30m/week to review vendor telemetry and playbook efficacy. Volunteers?

maria: I'll take week 1.

tara: I'll take week 2.

sam: Great. Keep updates here short (one-liners): e.g., "tara: PR merged", "ben: staging dashboard live", "maria: case #PV-3344". We'll close when prod rollouts are verified and DR passes. :white_check_mark:
